sequence.name: CozyMode Core Loop
sequence.completion_gate: Cozy Solo has a complete bounded low-pressure loop with explicit user preferences/delegation, activity selection, deterministic/domain-owned progress, human-choice/consent stop points, bounded background behavior, summaries/notifications, no-AI fallback, safe save/exit/resume and no setting-specific or unrestricted autonomy assumptions.

sequence.name: Connected Cozy and Shared Automated Play
Recovery, Safety, Acceptance and Implementation Handoff

design_rules: CozyMode setting-independent and low-pressure without hidden rule changes.
Personal context initial Cozy Solo host.
Background is opt-in and bounded with mandatory human/GM/stale/budget/consent stops.
Wall-clock not game time by default.
non_goals: No automatic human consent or irreversible advancement.
